payload.instruction: Screen Target Producer and Qwen vision parser, not final binder. Parse original PNGs plus raw-event overlay PNGs and actual event coordinates WITHOUT speech/intended answers. Overlay cross/path and event IDs are raw coordinates, not inferred targets. Use original frame pixel space with supplied width/height. Return ONLY compact JSON {candidates:[{target_id,frame_id,kind,label,bbox:[x1,y1,x2,y2]}],cue_relations:[{cue_id,target_ids,relation:'point_inside'|'within_region',complete:bool,unique:bool,navigation_alternative:bool}],coverage:{complete:bool,unknown:[strings],competing:[strings]},source_refs:[frame_ids]}. Use visible IDs, short visible header labels max60characters, accurate bboxes inside frame. Point-inside claims must actually contain the coordinate. A loop geometric sample set contains bbox centers within its polygon; inspect actual plotted samples. Preserve unknown/competing candidates/navigation alternatives; geometry alone is not designation. All relevant named alternatives, max30candidates. Expansion asks YOU to reread same pixels and repair missing/invalid extents. Never produce expression bindings. No prose or chain-of-thought.

payload.instruction: Speech Reference Producer. Interpret full transcript, expression spans, actual event timestamps and prior binding without pixels. Return ONLY compact JSON {intent:string,expressions:[{expression_id,kind,count:integer|null,relation:'designated_by_cue'|'within_region'|'explicit_ids'|'relative_position'|'correction'|'retain_prior'|'other',cue_ids:[event_id],explicit_target_ids:[IDs literally stated in speech],unresolved:[strings],meaning:string}],coverage:{complete:bool,unknown:[strings]}}. Every expression exactly once. Intent MUST describe the user requested action/topic/scope from the full transcript, never your internal reference detection or binding operation. Preserve any explicit speech count for mandatory final checking; singular designated item has count1. Connect cues using wording and time interval, not time alone; distinguish later navigation. For partial correction preserve retained/replaced scope. Intent max120characters, meaning max100characters; no final targets, invented visible IDs or chain-of-thought.
